caveats: Per-cell MHW threshold/climatology pools are the specified baseline days 1992-01-01 to 2002-12-31 plus the mandated +/-5 calendar-day extension days (1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05), which are not themselves baseline days. All 4020 required daily files were present; 3300 of 3600 region cells are sea cells (finite SST on every target day). All computations in float64 with hazen (type 5) percentiles.
